summary.intent: Run the full autonomous post-execute-phase pipeline for GSD Phase 68 (verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit review, ship, resolve PR reviews) without babysitting, triaging findings per fix-now-vs-defer-as-todo rules.
summary.outcome: Verify/secure/validate stages completed (verify accepted existing PASS, security audit committed 41/41 closed, validation updated to 0 gaps); SDK E2E gate reached all-green after diagnosing two environment issues; simplify pass found and fixed a real zeroization-order bug plus removed dead code; local CodeRabbit review findings were triaged and fixed across several services with commits landed; PR creation, ship, and PR-review-resolution steps had not yet started by transcript end.

repo: apps/api TEE_WORKER_URL config defaults to :3001, which is actually the mock-ipns-routing service port locally — the real tee-worker runs on :3002; misconfiguration silently produces TEE test failures that look like code regressions.
The local tee-worker Docker container can be running a stale pre-phase image (found running a pre-Phase-67 contract); must be rebuilt from current source before trusting SDK E2E TEE results.

Conventional commit format only requires the description part to be paren-free — scoped prefixes like `fix(sdk):` are valid and don't need rewording, contradicting the initial assumption that all 86 commits would need a filter-branch reword.
apps/web ipns.service.test.ts fails on both the phase branch and main, and apps/web's vitest suite isn't wired into any CI job — a pre-existing gap, not a phase regression.
apps/api/src/shares/shares.service.ts updateGrant had no service-level test coverage for the rootGeneration monotonic guard before this phase.

code.finding: enumerateMoveDescendants zeroed a parent readKey before the children loop finished unsealing with it, causing every depth-2+ move descendant to be misclassified as unreadable. Fixed and covered with a red-green-verified regression test (client-move-enumerate.test.ts).
Contained dead functions (including ensureFreshSentShares-related code) orphaned by the rotation cutover; removed after confirming zero external references.
Held dead code tied to the same rotation cutover; removed alongside share.service.ts cleanup.
updateGrant needed a monotonic guard on rootGeneration (CodeRabbit finding); added guard plus a new service-spec test case since none existed.
Multiple raw error-log call sites needed structured logging per CodeRabbit review; fixed across several edits.

workflow: Backgrounding long-running steps (security audit subagent, simplify-review subagent, SDK E2E build+run) let the orchestrator keep prepping PR content and checking gh/PR state in parallel instead of blocking on each.

When a fix's correctness is non-obvious, red-green verifying the new test (temporarily reverting the fix to confirm the test fails, then reapplying to confirm it passes) caught that the regression test actually exercised the bug rather than passing trivially.
For a puzzling pre-existing test failure, diffing the suspect file against main and swapping in main's version live was a fast way to prove the failure wasn't introduced by the phase.

friction: SDK E2E gate initially failed for environmental reasons (stale tee-worker image, wrong TEE_WORKER_URL default) rather than code bugs, requiring extended log/container investigation before the real cause was found.

Diagnosing the ipns.service.test.ts failure required an unusually long investigation (import-chain tracing, config diffing, live file-swapping against main) before concluding it was pre-existing and not CI-gated.

CodeRabbit's local review surfaced a large, spread-out set of findings (rotation-state.service.ts, ipns.service.ts, owner-reconcile.service.ts, shares.service.ts, client.ts) requiring careful cross-file tracing of rotation/reconcile state before fixes could be applied safely.
No existing service-level test coverage existed for shares.service.ts updateGrant, so a new test had to be authored from scratch mid-review rather than just extended.
